summary: The agent played the place for about 7 minutes over 3 episodes. It walked around both ends of the wall, collected coins, pulled the lever, visited the sign, waved and went through the door. Two clear bugs showed up in play. First, the goal pad (and the "You win!" screen) can be reached with 0 coins by walking around either end of the wall, which skips the door. Second, the Sign's script errors at start because the sign has no SurfaceGui, so the sign never shows its text. There are also smaller problems: "You win!" stays on the HUD for the rest of play, the HUD never shows coin progress, and the lever toggles but nothing reacts to it. Coins and the door worked as coded: the count went 0→6 with Coin3 worth 2, and the door opened when the count reached 5.
evidence: trace1.jsonl t=21.0-29.3: go_around_wall_right ended behind the wall at kit (1368, 2450) with coins=0 and the door closed (CanCollide true). Then walk_through_door_to_goal at t=36.1 arrived on the GoalPad at (-61, 2814). ReachedGoal became true and Hud.Status changed to 'You win!' while coins=0 and door_open=false
trace2.jsonl t=0.7-41.5: the same bypass worked again. It went round the right end to (1413, 2466) and round the left end to (-1391, 2532), then reached the goal pad at t=41.5 with 0 coins
Wall geometry (probe): WallLeft/WallRight span kit x -1120..1120 at y=2240, on a Baseplate 28672 cm half-wide, with nothing that blocks the ends

The game's error log in episodes 1 and 2 at t=0.0: [Error] Workspace.Sign.SignText:3: attempt to index nil with 'TextLabel'. A probe found /Workspace/Sign has only the child SignText and no SurfaceGui
trace1 t=0.3: [Warning] ContentId rbxassetid://203785492 failed: Asset type does not match requested type
trace3.jsonl t=6.5-17.9: coins 4→5→6. The door opened at 5 (CanCollide false, Transparency 0.8). Hud.Status stayed 'You win!' throughout, from the earlier goal touch, and never showed a coin count
trace2.jsonl t=123.1 / t=138.5: the lever toggled Pulled false→true→false and its colour changed grey→green→grey. The door and every other value stayed the same
A probe pressed Wave and F: the player attribute 'Waved' could not be read before or after. It is set by a LocalScript, so it lives on the client only. Not counted as a bug
findings: The goal can be reached without the coins. The Wall's two parts end at x=±1120 cm (±40 studs) on an open baseplate, so the player walks around either end onto the GoalPad and gets ReachedGoal and 'You win!' with 0 coins and the door closed (trace1 t=21-42, trace2 t=0.7-41.5). The goal pad's Touched handler doesn't check the coin count either.

The sign is blank and its script errors. Workspace.Sign has no SurfaceGui, so SignText.server.luau:3 throws 'attempt to index nil with TextLabel' at start and the 'Collect 5 coins to open the door' text never appears.

'You win!' stays on the HUD. Once it is set it never resets, and the HUD never shows the coin count or the 5-coin requirement. Hud.Status read 'You win!' while the player kept collecting coins (trace2/trace3).
The lever does nothing. Its ProximityPrompt toggles Pulled and the lever's colour, but no script reacts to it: the door, the goal and the HUD stay the same (trace2 t=123-146).
A ContentId warning at start: rbxassetid://203785492 'Asset type does not match requested type' (each play test).
prompt: Explore the game for bugs: Go through the place and tell me everything that looks wrong (10 minutes of play)
